using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Streaming.NATS;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Streaming.NATS.Tests
{
    public class NatsConnectionManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task Initialize_LogsError_WhenExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var options = new NatsOptions
            {
                StreamName = "testStream",
                ProducerCount = 1,
                PartitionCount = 1
            };

            var manager = new NatsConnectionManager("testProvider", loggerFactoryMock.Object, options);

            // We simulate failure by disposing the internal connection to cause an exception on connect
            // But since we cannot access internals, we rely on the real connection to fail or throw.
            // So we just call Initialize and expect it to throw and log error.

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => manager.Initialize(CancellationToken.None));

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error initializing NATS JetStream Connection Manager")),
                    ex,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Orleans.Streaming.NATS;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Streaming.NATS.Tests
{
    public class NatsConnectionManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task Initialize_LogsError_WhenExceptionThrown()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactory = new TestLoggerFactory();
            var options = new NatsOptions
            {
                StreamName = "testStream",
                ProducerCount = 1,
                PartitionCount = 1
            };

            var manager = new NatsConnectionManager("testProvider", loggerFactory, options);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => manager.Initialize(CancellationToken.None));

            Assert.Contains("Error initializing NATS JetStream Connection Manager", loggerFactory.LastErrorMessage);
            Assert.NotNull(loggerFactory.LastErrorException);
        }

        private class TestLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
        {
            public string? LastErrorMessage;
            public Exception? LastErrorException;

            public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) { }
            public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => new TestLogger(this);
            public void Dispose() { }

            private class TestLogger : ILogger
            {
                private readonly TestLoggerFactory _factory;
                public TestLogger(TestLoggerFactory factory) => _factory = factory;

                public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null!;
                public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

                public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
                {
                    if (logLevel == LogLevel.Error && exception != null)
                    {
                        _factory.LastErrorMessage = formatter(state, exception);
                        _factory.LastErrorException = exception;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Streaming.NATS;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Streaming.NATS.Tests
{
    public class NatsConnectionManagerEnqueueMessageTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task EnqueueMessage_LogsError_WhenNatsContextIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var options = new NatsOptions
            {
                StreamName = "testStream",
                ProducerCount = 1,
                PartitionCount = 1
            };

            var manager = new NatsConnectionManager("testProvider", loggerFactoryMock.Object, options);

            // Use reflection to set _natsContext to null to simulate uninitialized context
            var natsContextField = typeof(NatsConnectionManager).GetField("_natsContext", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            natsContextField.SetValue(manager, null);

            var message = new NatsStreamMessage
            {
                StreamId = new NatsStreamId
                {
                    Namespace = new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("ns")),
                    Key = new ReadOnlyMemory<byte>(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("key"))
                }
            };

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => manager.EnqueueMessage(message));

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Unable to enqueue message: NATS context is not initialized")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.Equal("Unable to enqueue message: NATS context is not initialized", ex.Message);
        }
    }
}
